caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a hinged lid that is partially open and features a vertical latch in the center front with a circular handle at the top. The surface of the box is primarily black and is decorated on all visible sides with a pattern of colorful garlands and bands in red, blue, and gold draped beneath a lattice motif in gold, along with stylized floral and leaf designs in yellow, red, and green. The lower part of the box has a repeating band of diagonal red, blue, and gold stripes on a black background. The drawing is rendered on a plain off-white or cream-colored background, with the image of the box centered and no other objects present.
title: Lunch Box
